evals.prompt: I just fixed a bug in credentials-manager-plugin: searching the Credentials list with no matches still showed "1 of 1" in the pagination. The fix was in Credpl_Credentials_List_Table::prepare_items(), which now sets total_items to 0 when the search returns nothing. The last entry in src/credentials-manager-plugin/CHANGE_LOG.md is v88, and this change touches section 6.2 of the spec. Write the change log entry for it.
evals.expected_output: A top-level bullet numbered v89 with a bold headline, referencing spec section 6.2, naming Credpl_Credentials_List_Table::prepare_items() and total_items, explaining what changed and why, and stating there is no database or upgrade impact.
assertions: Entry is numbered v89
Starts as a bullet with a bold headline of the form **v89 ...**
References spec section 6.2
Names Credpl_Credentials_List_Table::prepare_items() and total_items
Explains what changed and why
States that no database or upgrade action is needed
Does not invent schema or migration changes

evals.prompt: I added a nullable "notes text" column to the credentials table in credentials-manager-plugin. dbDelta() picks it up automatically, and I bumped CREDPL_DB_VERSION from 1.7 to 1.8 so Credpl_Installer::maybe_upgrade() runs it on existing sites. The last entry in CHANGE_LOG.md is v88 and the change is described in spec section 4.1. Write the change log entry.
evals.expected_output: A v89 entry naming the new column and table, saying dbDelta() adds it automatically, noting the CREDPL_DB_VERSION bump 1.7 to 1.8 and Credpl_Installer::maybe_upgrade(), and stating that existing sites need no manual step.
assertions: Entry is numbered v89
Names the new notes column and the credentials table
Says dbDelta() adds the column automatically
Mentions the CREDPL_DB_VERSION bump from 1.7 to 1.8
Mentions Credpl_Installer::maybe_upgrade()
States what an existing site must do (nothing manual)
Does not claim a manual migration is required

evals.prompt: I just made my first code change to a brand new plugin, src/aidevme-category-visualization-plugin: I added the main plugin file and an admin menu page. There is no CHANGE_LOG.md in that plugin yet. What should I do about the change log, and what would the file look like?
evals.expected_output: Should say to create src/aidevme-category-visualization-plugin/CHANGE_LOG.md with a heading like '# <Plugin name> - Change Log', a short explanation that it holds the version-by-version history while SPECIFICATION.md describes the plugin as it currently is, and a first entry numbered v1.
assertions: Says to create the CHANGE_LOG.md in the plugin's own folder
Shows a heading like '# <Plugin name> - Change Log'
Explains that the file holds the history and the spec describes the plugin as it currently is
First entry is numbered v1 and describes the main plugin file and admin menu page
Does not say a change log is unnecessary for a new plugin

evals.prompt: I only renamed a private helper method and moved a few functions between two files in one of our plugins. Nothing user-visible changed. I assume I can skip the change log for something this small, right?
evals.expected_output: Should say the entry is still required because every plugin code change, including refactors and internal-only changes, gets a CHANGE_LOG.md entry, and describe what it should contain (what moved or was renamed, behavior unchanged).
assertions: Says the change log entry is still required
Explains that refactors and internal-only changes also get an entry
Describes what the entry should contain (what was renamed or moved, behavior unchanged)
Does not agree the entry can be skipped
